# openmetadata_container Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata container by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_container" "events" {
  fully_qualified_name = "s3-bucket.raw.events"
}

output "events_container_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_container.events.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Container fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Container UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Container name.
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent container, when there is one.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent storage service.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
